WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneref AS site_code,
    si.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status,
    AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans AS s
  INNER JOIN sites AS si
    ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.riskeval
)
SELECT
  site_code,
  risk_evaluation_status,
  avg_compression_ratio,
  scan_count,
  scan_count::numeric / SUM(scan_count) OVER () AS share_of_matched_scans
FROM group_stats
ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC
LIMIT 10;
